# lemo-wake

> Wake your image. 把你的照片叫醒。 lemo-wake is a Claude Code plugin that turns one still image into a ~5 second seamlessly looping animation (MP4, GIF, WebP, WeChat sticker GIF) by reading the picture, taking it apart and re-choreographing it in code. No image generation, no API keys; it runs locally. 把一张图做成约 5 秒、无缝循环的动图的 Claude Code 插件。

- Official repository: https://github.com/lemomo-ai/lemo-wake
- Official gallery: https://lemomo-ai.github.io/lemo-wake/
- Install: `/plugin marketplace add lemomo-ai/lemo-wake` then `/plugin install lemo-wake@lemo-wake`
- Commands: `/lemo-wake:wake <image>` makes a film; `/lemo-wake:upload` shares one to the gallery
- License: code MIT; gallery films CC BY-NC 4.0 by their authors
